title: Quality-gate success record (build-pass)
description: Appended by feature-implementer when the quality gate (scripts/gate.sh verify) passes. Replaces the legacy 'delete build-failure.md on success' semantics: append-only requires an explicit success marker so the coordinator can route to reviewers based on the latest build-* record being a pass. The retry trail (preceding build-failure records) is preserved for diagnostic purposes.

gate_checks_run.description: Which gate verbs ran and passed (e.g. ["deps", "format", "lint", "test", "build"]). Optional; if absent, assume the full gate (scripts/gate.sh verify).

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock time spent in the gate. Optional, useful for monitoring.
